relationships.subject: S6K1
relationships.evidence_quote: The mTOR effector S6K1 is essential for c-Fos biosynthesis.

relationships.subject: DG2
relationships.evidence_quote: DG2 blocked preferential translation of c-Fos after the addition of NGF/IL-6 but importantly had no effect on the production of the GAPDH control

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Phosphorylation of S6 at amino acids 235 and 236 was increased by NGF/IL-6 treatment and this was again abolished by co-treatment with DG2

relationships.subject: T-5224
relationships.evidence_quote: Both doses prevented priming at 24 h but did not have an effect at the 1-h time point

key_findings: NGF/IL-6 promote S6K1-dependent c-Fos translation in DRG neurons.
Inhibiting S6K1 (DG2) or c-Fos (T-5224) reduces nociceptor firing and inflammatory/priming hypersensitivity.
